items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta Interview, 1957-03-21
items.q: And Toodlum, who would play around Toodlum's place a lot was Buddy Petit, Rene, Chris Kelly.

ctx.x: Tell us about Toodlum's place. Toodlum, well... Duncan, Sidney Bichet used to talk about him.
And Toodlum, who would play around Toodlum's place a lot was Buddy Petit, Rene, Chris Kelly. Punch. Punch. Punch player? That during time was Punch time. Yeah. It was in Punch time. So...
What sort of fellow was Toodlum? Quiet, nice, fine?
